punchline: The voices in your head fit in a mason jar, and the jar comes with a volume knob.
thirty_sec: Anne Lamott has an exercise for the critical voices in a writer's head. Close your eyes, picture each speaker as a mouse, pick it up by the tail, drop it into a mason jar and put on the lid. The mice claw at the glass. Turn the jar's volume all the way up for a minute and listen, then all the way down, and get back to your shitty first draft.
